title: Rav Nachman bar Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.25b.3), Rav Nachman bar Rava says in Rav’s name that kindling the Shabbat lights is an obligation. Hyman cites [Dikdukei Soferim, Shabbat 25b, p. 47](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/hF923F9uFWAC?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA47) for Rav Chanin bar Rava. Hyman is certain that this is the Rav Nachman bar Abba who says in Rav’s name in [Avodah Zarah 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.39a.2-3), “This is sultanit.”[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat names Rav Nachman bar Rava as an alternative to Rav Nachman bar Rav Zavda. The printed apparatus gives Rav Chanin bar Rava in the corresponding variant column. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2684&lang=en) also discusses the citation. The two passages give different patronymics. Hyman reads both as referring to the same man.
